capabilities: Embed GitLab issues, merge requests, and projects in notes
Render embeds in preview mode from pasted GitLab URLs
Fetch embed data from gitlab.com or self-hosted GitLab instances
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and the README discloses that it makes network requests to configured GitLab instances.
problem: Obsidian cannot render GitLab URLs as rich embeds, so references to issues and merge requests stay as plain links without context.

relations.evidence: embeds GitLab resources (issues, merge requests, projects, and more) directly into your notes

summary: Embeds GitLab issues, merge requests, and projects into notes as rendered previews fetched from a GitLab instance.
